name: agent-proctor
description: 第三方独立 Agent 监考/评测引擎（三轴）。用例资产由被测项目以 papers-v1 考卷库持有。

scripts.validate:examples: npm run proctor -- item validate --project examples/demo-project && npm run validate:product-eval
scripts.validate:product-eval: npm run proctor -- item validate --project examples/product-eval --check-fixtures
scripts.smoke:offline: npm run proctor -- run --dataset smoke-a-l1 --environment fold-v1 --project examples/demo-project && npm run proctor -- run --dataset smoke-a --environment fake-host-v1 --project examples/demo-project && npm run proctor -- run --dataset smoke-a-l3 --environment fake-host-v1 --project examples/demo-project && npm run proctor -- run --dataset model-core --environment model-direct-v1 --project examples/demo-project && npm run proctor -- run --dataset smoke-c-echo --environment shell-echo-v1 --project examples/demo-project && npm run proctor -- run --dataset smoke-c-write --environment shell-echo-v1 --project examples/demo-project
scripts.smoke:wanxiangshu: npm run proctor -- run --dataset st-real-git --environment git-coordinator-v1 --project examples/wanxiangshu-papers
scripts.smoke:wanxiangshu:l1: npm run proctor -- run --dataset smoke-a-l1 --environment fold-wanxiangshu-v1 --project examples/wanxiangshu-papers
scripts.smoke:plugin-fakehost: npm run proctor -- run --dataset smoke-a-l2-plugin --environment fake-host-plugin-v1 --project examples/wanxiangshu-papers
scripts.eval:model: npm run proctor -- run --dataset eval-model --environment hosted-plain-v1 --project examples/product-eval
scripts.eval:model:demo-schema: npm run proctor -- run --dataset eval-model --environment model-direct-v1 --project examples/demo-project
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run validate:examples
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify && npm run smoke:offline
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build
